cue-person-check 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Cue「人物核查」research skill.
- Supports in-depth "person background check" using cross-referenced public data with source links.
- Provides practical research templates, including executive history checks, fund manager claim verification, and bulk key person risk screening.
- Integration with Cue runner required; setup instructions included.
- Automated selection and matching of research templates based on user queries.
- Explicit credit usage confirmation implemented before each deep research run.
